requirements.general: Entry Level and Requirements Foundation: Certificate from any PPT recognised by the Ministry of Education or government of Malaysia with CGPA 2.0 Diploma: Diploma in the relevant field from other institutions recognised by the government of Malaysia with CGPA ≥ 2.00 STPM : Grade C+ CGPA 2.33 in 2 subjects and SPM credit in Mathematics and a pass in English  A-Level : 2Ds UEC : 5 subjects at grade B including a pass in Mathematics and English OR a pass in SPM Mathematics and English SACE : 5 subject with ATAR of 55 NSW (HSC) : 10 units with ATAR of 55 CPU : 6 passes with an average of 55 TEE : 4 or 5 subjects with ATAR of 55 Australian Year 12 : TER/UAI/ENTER 55 Others : Other equivalent qualifications as recognised by the government of Malaysia. Note: International students are subject to meet entry requirements that reflect similar qualifications and experience as stated above.
